name: io.github.sarooo17/event-intelligence
title: MCP Event Intelligence
description: MCP-native CEP for durable agents: event-time patterns, semantic predicates, derived events.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_WRITE_ENABLED
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to expose persistent trigger mutation tools. Read-only by default.

environmentVariables.name: RUNTIME_WAKE_TARGETS_JSON
environmentVariables.description: Optional operator-configured signed runtime wake targets.

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional TypeSafe Jev API key for explicit semantic Pattern AST nodes.

environmentVariables.name: TYPESAFE_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional TypeSafe Jev model override. Defaults to jev-latest.
